description: This is a Java interface defining methods for writing provisioning entries within the Fineract provisioning service. It includes method signatures for creating provisioning entries, recreating them, and creating associated journal entries, utilizing command and domain classes.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining write operations for provisioning entries, including creation and re-creation of entries and journal entries.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Creates provisioning entries based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Creates a single provisioning entry for a specified date, with an option to add journal entries.

methods.name: reCreateProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Recreates provisioning entries identified by the given provisioningEntryId, using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: createProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Creates journal entries associated with a specified provisioning entry.
